items.name: dml-dynamic-panel
items.description: working paper 'Double Machine Learning for Dynamic Panel Data: Inference in High-Dimensional Time Series'. Includes LaTeX source, blocked-time cross-fitting (optional buffer), orthogonal partialling-out score, clustered SEs, and simulations/empirical checks.

items.name: dynamic-panel-monte-carlo
items.description: This repository hosts an econometric simulation framework designed to analyze, visualize, and benchmark the finite-sample performance of estimators in dynamic panel data models. Using a Monte Carlo simulations to quantify the mathematical breakdown of standard estimators under Nickell Bias (O(1/T)) presence in autoregressive AR(1) environments.

items.name: pyxtabond2
items.description: PyXtabond2: Dynamic Panel Data Estimation in Python

items.name: dynapanel
items.description: Experimental Python implementation of Difference/System GMM for dynamic panel data. Inspired by Stata's xtabond2.

items.name: Controlled_Random_Division
items.description: Automated facade panelization tool for Rhino. Generates dynamic panel systems with random sizing along any curve. Includes automatic extrusion and layer organization for architectural design workflows.

items.name: camp-day4
items.description: Monte Carlo study of the dynamic panel AR(1) coefficient: pooled OLS vs first differences vs within, tracking bias, dispersion and coverage as panel length T varies

items.name: pyrics
items.description: Pyrics — Python Lyrics Player  |  A minimalistic, modern, and monochrome floating desktop lyrics visualizer built in Python with PyQt6. Synchronized TTML subtitle files and floats lyrics upward across the screen in dynamic panel.

items.name: Maxetui
items.description: MaxetUI is a modern, reusable terminal UI template built with Python and Blessed. It features a responsive full-screen layout, sidebar navigation, dynamic panels, keyboard controls, live updates, and automatic terminal resize handling. Perfect for dashboards, CLI tools, admin panels, and terminal-based applications.
